title: handoff-revoke input
description: ENFORCED — the engine validates this ASSEMBLED stage input against this schema BEFORE the stage runs (engine/validation.py validate_stage_input; fail-closed, engine/config/runtime-binding.yaml input_validation: enforce). Shape below is the POST-adapter payload delivered at stage ?.

reason.description: Why the compensation fired (downstream failure context); recorded verbatim in the revoke receipt.

original_receipt.description: The handoff receipt being reversed (shape: handoff-to-deploy schemas/output.json). The revoke target derives from original_receipt.receipt_id; stop blocked on null or a non-handed_off status.

confirmation.description: Optional named revoke confirmation. The engine's compensation trigger supplies none today — the named decision lives in the typed HITL resolution record; threading it into this payload is a ledgered engine follow-up. NEVER reuse the forward handoff's approver.

idempotency_key.description: engine-injected: invocation identity. Business dedupe key is original_receipt.receipt_id — same key + same normalized input => byte-identical receipt; an already-compensated receipt never triggers a second rollback.

upstream_artifacts.description: engine-injected: producer stage id -> artifact path.
